dz: 两百名荷兰贵族由亨德里克·范·布雷德洛德(英语:Hendrick van Brederode)率领,逼迫自己去帕尔马的玛格丽特在场并呈递"妥协请愿书",谴责了西班牙在17个省份的宗教裁判所.
de: Two hundred Dutch noblemen, led by Hendrick van Brederode, force themselves into the presence of Margaret of Parma and present the Petition of Compromise, denouncing the Spanish Inquisition in the Seventeen Provinces.

t: 查尔斯五世让皇家进入了罗马,摧毁了这座城市的一整块地来重新实现罗马的胜利.
te: Charles V makes a Royal Entry into Rome, demolishing a swath of the city to re-enact a Roman triumph.
dz: 查尔斯五世让皇家进入了罗马,摧毁了这座城市的一整块地来重新实现罗马的胜利.
de: Charles V makes a Royal Entry into Rome, demolishing a swath of the city to re-enact a Roman triumph.

t: 在皮普斯湖冰上之战中,由亚历山大·涅夫斯基率领的俄军反击了特奥特尼克骑士的入侵企图.
te: During the Battle on the Ice of Lake Peipus, Russian forces, led by Alexander Nevsky, rebuff an invasion attempt by the…
dz: 在皮普斯湖冰上之战中,由亚历山大·涅夫斯基率领的俄军反击了特奥特尼克骑士的入侵企图.
de: During the Battle on the Ice of Lake Peipus, Russian forces, led by Alexander Nevsky, rebuff an invasion attempt by the Teutonic Knights.

dz: 法蒂米德第二次入侵埃及开始,当法蒂米德的继承人-父母al-Qa'im bi-Ammr Allah从拉卡达出发以领导他的军队.
de: The second Fatimid invasion of Egypt begins, when the Fatimid heir-apparent, al-Qa'im bi-Amr Allah, sets out from Raqqada at the head of his army.

t: 洛泰一世被教宗帕夏一世加冕为意大利国王.
te: Lothair I is crowned King of Italy by Pope Paschal I.
dz: 洛泰一世被教宗帕夏一世加冕为意大利国王.
